comments.value:
Also having this issue and hoping for a quick fix! I depend heavily on using the auto leveling feature since auto track tries to center the camera on my avatars view position.

This leaves a lot of emoty space in the top half of the screen and the bottom half is effectively cut off.

Yes please revert this "bug fix" back. It allows so much content creators to use it like a drone or proper follow cam without needing an avatar addon like vrclens on every avatar. 

An example of how some dancers use the cam

https://youtu.be/eqvneQOEhDw
Hoping this gets fixed soon. Streamers and dancers use this a lot.
If this could please be fixed ASAP its really impacting how I make content :(
The amount of people impacted by this bug is not small. I hope for the sake of all these users that are popularizing vrchat, it is fixed/patched quickly. Thank you.

I'm pretty sure there are a lot of unheard voices but the lot of us have been using this feature for creating content, I've personally been using it for photography, cinematography and dancing and would really like to see it come back or even have a separate toggle that would capture the entire body like how it worked before. Thanks in advance!

VRChat release 2023.2.4 build 1319 release notes listed "Fixed issued when using the camera with auto-level and and look-at-me are both enabled". I'm unsure if this fix didn't work as intended. Or if there's conflicting opinions on how these two settings should work together. Just mentioning it, for context.

Just checked 10 mins ago and still not fixed. Really hope theyre make this a priority! Has anyone heard anything on how long we will be waiting for a fix. Dont really want to stream vrchat without this feature

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: March 1st, 2023? Even though this issues has been going on for days since the (now second to) last update?

1 - Major release within quarter.

details:
1. Open camera

2. Turn on camera Look-At-Me toggle

3. Turn on automatic levelling

Automatic levelling will not function as the player looks around.

Twitch clip showing it not working: https://clips.twitch.tv/VictoriousObedientKimchiShazBotstix-_wlGWbp2__9ujdLO
title: Camera Automatic Levelling Incompatible with Look-At-Me feature
